cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Acknowledge Our History
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize that the relationship, memory, or sacrifice mattered and cannot be treated as incidental.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't bin our ferry ticket yet. Put it with the overtime slips; that weekend took three late shifts each.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We missed the ferry. I hate being reminded.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: File it as a missed crossing, not a wasted weekend. We stayed together anyway. Keep the hotel receipt with it, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Keep the receipt, then. That part was lovely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Write that on the envelope: 'That part was lovely.' In your handwriting, please. I can supply the dates; I need those words from you.

reason: Use careful classification and labelling to preserve B own acknowledgement, accepting the hotel keepsake instead of insisting every part was good.
